entities.title: Bottle archive
entities.summary: The archive brew pours for the zazzle formula: its name, its layout and its checksum in the formula's bottle block.
consumers: Homebrew, when a user runs brew install or brew upgrade on zazzcat/z/zazzle
guarantees: Named zazzle-VERSION.all.bottle.tar.gz (one hyphen), the name Homebrew downloads from a plain root_url

Holds exactly zazzle/VERSION/: bin/ with only zazzle, libexec/zazzle/ with daemon, zazz-script-runner, shell-tools, fix-network, free-disk-space, git-tools, git-tools-commit, git-tools-commit-message-editor, ai-agent-rules and cyberspace-generator (mode 0755, owned by 0:0), and libexec/indexer/ with the two gzipped indexers
Holds no z: post_install_steps decide whether to link HOMEBREW_PREFIX/bin/z
Reproducible: the same files give the same archive
The formula's bottle block names the release's download folder as root_url, one sha256 tagged all, with cellar :any_skip_relocation
entities.compatibility: Fixed by Homebrew (Bottle::Filename#url_encode and Bottle#extract_snapshot); a change here breaks brew install.

entities.title: Each binary names itself in its version output
entities.summary: The formula's test block runs zazzle version, zazzle daemon --version, zazzle zazz help, libexec/zazzle/zazz-script-runner version and zazzle TOOL --version for the other tools, and expects each output to contain the tool's name.
consumers: The formula's test block (brew test zazzle)
guarantees: zazzle version prints zazzle; zazzle zazz help prints zazz; zazz-script-runner version prints zazz-script-runner; zazzle TOOL --version prints the tool's name for daemon, fix-network, free-disk-space, git-tools, ai-agent-rules, shell-tools, csharp-indexer and cyberspace-generator
entities.compatibility: Renaming a crate or binary changes what it prints and breaks brew test. formula.test.sh checks that the test block runs these ten commands, but its stand-in answers for the binaries, so a mismatch with what they really print is not caught there.
